text:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy finished -> some canary pods failing healthchecks. pipeline #1247 promoted image redwood/inference:stable (pushed at 2026-03-15T09:17Z). healthchecks: 6/10 pods CrashLoopBackOff or 5xx. logs attached: `registry push ok, manifest updated, digest: sha256:abc123...`

Ben SRE: paging oncall - I'm awake. assigning to myself for triage. @Alice Platform @Carmen Eng can you grab the artifact chain? :rotating_light:

Alice Platform: seeing 5xx spikes from inference-api-canary, traces show model init failing with "kv-cache checksum mismatch" and repeated OOMs in startup. stack shows layer loader complaining about unexpected layer size. suspect mutable tag overwrite (retagged stable -> different digest).

Carmen Eng: confirmed - CI promoted a build and then the promotion job re-ran and pushed a different image to the same tag `redwood/inference:stable`. registry audit shows two pushes within 3m with different digests. this created tag drift and probably a layer mismatch for existing running nodes (they pulled layers from cache). pipeline log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T09:16:31Z] promote: tagging redwood/inference:stable -> sha256:abc123
[2026-03-15T09:18:02Z] promote: tagging redwood/inference:stable -> sha256:def456
```

David Release: hmm. canary health failing and we have customers seeing errors. options: 1) rollback cluster to prior deployment (pin digest) 2) flip feature flag to stop routing traffic to the new path 3) kill the canary rollout. what's safest?

Esme Support: incoming customer reports: Acme Corp and TwoDot see increased 502s starting ~09:19Z. Acme ticket #INC-5839 created. TL;DR: user-facing errors for ~10-12% of requests hitting inference route.

Ben SRE: quick mitigation - flip the new routing flag so production traffic stays on stable backend while we investigate. executing now.

Ben SRE: ```
# flip feature-flag to disable new routing
ffctl set inference-routing.v2 false --env=prod --actor=ben.sre
# check status
ffctl get inference-routing.v2 --env=prod
```

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-01 created (severity: P2). oncall: Ben SRE. responders: Alice Platform, Carmen Eng, David Release.

Carmen Eng: promotion job temporarily disabled, re-run prevented. I'm blocking any further pushes to `:stable` and adding a pipeline gate to error if tag already exists. quick patch to CI: add `--disable-retag` and require digest pinning in manifests.

Alice Platform: after flip, error rate dropped from 11% -> 1.2% within two minutes. canary pods still crashing on startup if re-created, but user traffic is not routed there now. monitoring: CPU/Memory stable.

David Release: will we want to rollback the canary or delete the canary deployment entirely? recommendation: delete canary pods, redeploy with pinned digest if we need a new canary. for now keep stable routing until CI fix is in.

Esme Support: letting affected customers know: estimated impact window 09:17Z-09:29Z, ~12 minutes. I've updated tickets and sent initial status to Acme.

Carmen Eng: created follow-up PR to CI to enforce immutable tags and to fail promotion if tag exists. also filing a change to our registry policy to block retags for production namespaces. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci/pull/419

Ben SRE: handing off to next oncall @David Release for cleanup and postmortem. my shift ends in 6m. next steps for handoff: 1) confirm CI gate merged 2) delete canary deployment 3) redeploy canary from pinned digest if we want to re-test 4) postmortem + customer-impact timeline.

David Release: taking over. I will delete the canary and follow the pinned-digest flow. adding action items to release checklist and scheduling postmortem meeting.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-01 severity downgraded to P3 at 2026-03-15T09:34Z after mitigation.

Alice Platform: summary for postmortem (short): root cause = pipeline retag of `stable` producing tag drift -> nodes pulled inconsistent layers -> startup integrity checks failed (kv-cache mismatch). customer impact: subset of inference requests routed to canary experienced 5xx/502 for ~12 min. mitigation: feature-flag kill-switch flipped to stop routing (Ben), promotion job disabled (Carmen), CI gate added (Carmen), registry policy follow-up.

David Release: creating postmortem doc and will link action items. estimated follow-ups: enforce digest pinning in deploy manifests, add registry retag detection alert, hard-fail when pipeline attempts to push an existing tag.

Esme Support: closing customer communications loop after doc.

Ben SRE: good job team. :thumbsup: closing my oncall.

(End of thread)
